init.instructions: Validate explicit operator, language, mailbox scope, Dropbox catalog and Portal review storage. Dispatch init once through the Activepieces client; return actual initialized/missing status. Do not run a scan or change schedules.

add-communication.description: Submit customer communication for one workbench review.
add-communication.instructions: Require initialized workspace and explicit source plus customer identity when not supplied by a Gmail source. Submit the exact payload to Activepieces; stop at the actual review link. Do not write CRM or send messages from the plugin.

reply-draft.description: Submit an inquiry for a grounded draft and workbench review.
reply-draft.instructions: Require initialized workspace, actual Gmail message ID and exact registered project/lot. Submit once; return the actual draft review. Do not send, consume Consent, draft a second copy locally or query Dropbox directly.

report.description: Show the report returned by the report flow.
report.instructions: Submit the empty report payload and show its actual result. No mailbox scan, business task execution, CRM writes or customer notifications. Report can describe missing initialization.
